achievement: Her avant-garde fiction, such as 'Love in the New Millennium', 'Frontier', 'The Last Lover' and 'Five Spice Street', which uses dreamlike, labyrinthine prose to explore the inner self and resist conventional narrative.
rationale: This is a speculative guess, since the 2026 prize has not been announced as of today. Recent laureates were European men in 2023 (Fosse) and 2025 (Krasznahorkai), so the Academy may rotate to a woman from outside Europe. Can Xue, a Chinese writer, has been a frequent top contender and is internationally respected for experimental work in Krasznahorkai's tradition. Anne Carson, Mircea Cărtărescu and Gerald Murnane are other strong possibilities.
